changelog: Notchy (Pro) follows Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity on its own, and you can answer Claude Code's questions and permission requests from the notch.
System stats: CPU, memory, network, storage, battery and uptime in one view; pick the tiles you want.
Desktop PCs no longer show a 100% battery; choose what the closed notch shows instead.
Focus timer redesign: bigger, drag tasks to reorder, sort, and add several tasks in a row.
Smoother lyrics, and long lines no longer lose their last letters.
Fixed the camera dot staying on after the camera was closed.
Fewer "not responding" reports when Windows updates Smart Notch or shuts down.
